newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev rebounds from all-time lows at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev rebounds from all-time lows at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 245-247 per dollar, firmer than 255-256 all-time lows in the early afternoon but still weaker than 238-242 in the morning despite support from several banks, dealers said.
"Large state-owned bank launched dollar sales in the afternoon, boosting the lev in light volumes," a dealer said.
A sharp rise of foreign currency demand pressured the lev to 255-256 per dollar in the early afternoon amid very low supply on the interbank market, traders said.
Bank and clients rushed to convert levs into hard currency because of expectations of a sharper lev fall, traders said.
The lev closed at 233 on Wednesday.
The central bank was not seen supporting the lev directly in the market but was presumed to have offered small foreign currency volumes to end customers, dealers said.
